question: Windfall gains are NOT included while calculating national income as _____________.

options.text: there is no productive activity connected with them

solution: The correct answer is __**there is no productive activity connected with them**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Windfall gains** are unexpected or sudden profits that arise from unforeseen events such as natural resources being discovered or an unexpected increase in the value of assets. • These **gains do not result from any productive activity or efforts that contribute to the economy’s output.** • **National income** is calculated based on the value added by productive activities in the economy (i.e., goods and services produced). • Since** windfall gains are not linked to any productive activity, they are excluded from the calculation of national income.**
